27.4. Sievert Integral
\int_0^\theta e^{-x \sec \phi}d\phi
Relation to the Error Function
27.4.1  \int_0^\theta e^{-x \sec \phi}d\phi\sim\sqrt{\frac{\pi}{2x}}e^{-x} \mathrm{erf}\left(\sqrt{\frac{x}{2}}\theta\right) \quad (x\to\infty)
(For erf, see chapter 7.)
Representation in Terms of Exponential Integrals
27.4.2  \int_0^\theta e^{-x \sec \phi}d\phi=\int_0^{\tfrac{\pi}{2}} e^{-x \sec \phi}d\phi-\sum_{k=0}^\infty \alpha_k(\cos \theta)^{2k+1}E_{2k+2}\left(\frac{x}{\cos \theta}\right) \quad \left(x\geq0, 0<\theta<\frac{\pi}{2}\right)
\alpha_0=1, \alpha_k=\frac{1\cdot3\cdot5\dots(2k-1)}{2\cdot4\cdot6\dots(2k)}
(For E_{2k+2}(x), see chapter 5.)
Relation to the Integral of the Bessel Function K_0(x)
27.4.3  \int_0^{\tfrac{\pi}{2}} e^{-x \sec \phi}d\phi=\mathrm{Ki}_1(x)=\int_x^\infty K_0(t)dt \quad \text{where}
x^{\tfrac12}e^x\mathrm{Ki}_1(x)\sim(\tfrac12\pi)^{\tfrac12}\left\{1-\frac{5}{8x}+\frac{129}{128x^2}-\frac{2655}{1024x^3}+\frac{301035}{32768x^4}-\dots\right\}
(For Ki_1(x), see chapter 11.)
